title: Canonical evaluation on a localized module
statement: Let A be an N-graded commutative ring, f in A, g in B=A_(f), and p a point of D₊(f). Let F:A_f→A_p be the canonical localization map. If F(g) is a unit, then there is an additive map e:(A_f)_g→A_p extending F and satisfying e(a*x)=F(a)*e(x) for a in B.

source.place: Lemma 27.8.4 and its preceding construction, specialized to the shift A(k); this split separates ordinary gluing from degree detection

proof.text: Give A_p its B-action via B→A_f→A_p. The canonical F is B-linear. Each power of g acts invertibly because F(g) is a unit. Mathlib LocalizedModule.lift constructs the map; lift_comp and map_smul give the two identities.

proof_origin.place: Section 27.8; Lemma 27.8.1 and preceding construction; G3 second reading supplies the explicit localization argument.

theorem twist_finiteLocal_canonical_eval
    {A σ : Type v} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (f : A) (g : HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f)
    (p : basicOpen 𝒜 f)
    (hunit : IsUnit ((IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers f)
      (T := p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl)
      (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) (RingHom.id A)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr p.2))
      (algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f) (Localization.Away f) g))) :
    let M := LocalizedModule.Away f A
    letI : Module (HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f) M :=
      Module.compHom M (algebraMap _ (Localization.Away f))
    ∃ e : LocalizedModule.Away g M →+
        Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal,
      (∀ z : M, e (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers g) M z) =
        IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers f)
          (T := p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl)
          (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) (RingHom.id A)
          (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr p.2) z) ∧
      (∀ (a : HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f)
        (x : LocalizedModule.Away g M),
        e (a • x) =
          (IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers f)
            (T := p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl)
            (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) (RingHom.id A)
            (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr p.2)
            (algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f)
              (Localization.Away f) a)) * e x)
